narratives.body: NBC Sports reports that Bradley Beal is ruled out for the game against Sacramento due to a knee injury and remains unavailable for the match against the Lakers.
narratives.headline: Bradley Beal ruled out for Sacramento and Lakers games

narratives.body: ABC30 Fresno reports that the Los Angeles Clippers have indicated the jersey number previously worn by Chris Paul will be assigned to Bradley Beal.
narratives.headline: Clippers assign Chris Paul's old No. 3 to Bradley Beal
